entities.summary: Altheim culture is a Chalcolithic culture that derives its name from the town of Altheim. It is also a subgroup of Lengyel culture. Not defined until 1915 by the German Prehistorian Paul Reinecke after finds from a Causewayed enclosure 1000 m northwest of Altheim (Essenbach), Landshut (district), in Lower Bavaria, Southeastern Germany.
